summary: Review-required audit trail for the live Windows.old cleanup card. The app already ships this file-backed cleanup action and the repo cleanup docs describe the same rollback-sensitive folder, but the card has not yet been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.

setting.name: Delete Windows.old Folder
setting.casual_explanation: This deletes the Windows.old folder that can hold files needed to roll back to a previous Windows version.
setting.why_people_change_it: People remove Windows.old when they want to reclaim disk space after deciding they no longer need the rollback path to the previous installation.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Deleting Windows.old can reclaim a large amount of disk space, but it also removes the ability to roll back to the previous Windows version through that retained folder.
setting.professional_notes: The current app enumerates fixed drives and deletes Windows.old directories it finds. Repo cleanup docs describe the same rollback-sensitive folder and note that removing it is not reversible through the app.

allowed_values.label: No cleanup action
allowed_values.meaning: Windows.old remains available until the operator or Windows removes it.

allowed_values.label: Delete Windows.old
allowed_values.meaning: Deletes Windows.old folders on fixed drives, removing that rollback folder from the system.

targets.notes: This is a one-shot cleanup action rather than a persistent rollback policy setting.

decision.why: The live cleanup behavior and repo-backed folder target are clear, but this one-shot cleanup card still lives only in the first-party provider.
blocking_issues: The card has not yet been promoted from the first-party cleanup provider into the research-provider surface.
Deleting Windows.old has no rollback path through the app.
decision.promotion_disposition_reason: Closed as rejected for research-provider promotion because the live action is one-shot, destructive, high-risk, reboot-sensitive, or lacks a rollback story suitable for a validated tweak card.
decision.promotion_reopen_criteria: Reopen only if the app gains a verified rollback/snapshot contract and dedicated validation proof for the exact action.
